description: This file defines the MaintenanceDao class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends a base DAO and provides a method extractDataFromEmpNumber to query employee data from a specified table based on employee number.

classes.name: MaintenanceDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for maintenance operations related to employee data extraction.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches data from a specified table using employee number with optional join clauses.
